# Claims Register: plausible-but-false claims on our websites (ORDER #3575)

Built 11.22.2026 00:15 CT by the Lane 2 driver run. Read-only: no website, listing or published document was edited, and nothing was sent.

**How to use this:** put TRUE, FALSE or UNSURE in the last column of any row that says `____`. Rows Mimi already ruled on 11.18.2026 (ORDERs #3602, #3603, #3605) are pre-marked and are not being asked again. Once the column is filled, the Box writes Katherine's correction page from the FALSE rows and takes the same lines out of our internal knowledge files.

**What was crawled (11.22.2026 00:11 CT):** 10 sites, every published page AND blog post, read through brain-core `box_jobs/blog_corpus/blog_corpus.py` (WordPress REST API or sitemap; public copy only). infinityhospitalitygroup.com (14 pages, 9 posts), thebridgebuilding.com (24, 12), thebelltower.com (24, 4), cherokeedock.com (28, 1), saddlewoodsfarm.com (17, 1), thecordelle.com (16, 0), thesaintelle.com (17, 1), estellenashville.com (17, 1), dreameventsandcatering.com (17, 145), dailydishcatering.com (10, 0). The Elle sites (Cordelle, Saint Elle, Estelle) were included because their domains are already in the crawler. Mimi's first pass said 9 sites; this run found 10 on disk and does not know which one her count left out. Claim patterns: original/originally, built in/by, founded, since <year>, once/formerly, historic, any 1800s year, only/first/largest/oldest/award/voted/world's/record, and capacities, acres and square feet. That pulled 402 sentences. The rows below are the ones that make a checkable claim about us; the rest are generic copy ("historic charm"), advice in blog posts, or claims about other companies' venues in Dream's and IHG's roundup posts, which are not ours to rule. The full list is in `05_AI_and_Brain/box_driver_state/scratch_L2/claims_3575.tsv`.

**Source column:** "Mimi 11.18.2026" means she ruled it by popup. "Internal:" names a file of ours that says the same thing or something different. No web search for outside sources was run this time, so a row with no outside source says "not searched", never "no source exists".

**Standing rule kept here:** our own copy does not state a hard venue capacity (#3605). Where a capacity row is a mismatch, Katherine gets both numbers side by side; the Box picks neither.
